newsitem.title: GERMANY: German average public bond yield hits record low.
newsitem.headline: German average public bond yield hits record low.

text.p: The average current yield on German public debt on Wednesday fell below five percent to an all time record low of 4.99 percent, according to data supplied by the Bundesbank.
German yields have fallen sharply in recent months on evidence of sluggish domestic economic growth and low inflation.
Yields fell further on Wednesday following a rise in U.S. debt prices after benign U.S. consumer price data allayed fears of a U.S. interest rate rise soon.
